notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a short primary replication claim-evaluation report, not a preregistration or secondary original-study report. Paragraphs 1–4 identify Humphrey_SocSciMed_2017_Eb2N, replication team Bob Reed/Jianhua Duan/Sanghyun Hong, SCORE RR ID 23yw2, and OSF project rywgh, matching the neutral reference project and identifier. Paragraph 32 supplies the matching Humphrey and Root title, journal, year and DOI. The neutral reference lists project-level authors different from the explicitly named replication team; no independent date verification is available in this text. The report contains one single-trace claim and its replication result, supporting target identity without row-order or numeric matching. It names separate estimation output and data files that were not supplied or inspected. Analytic N and exclusions cannot be established. Retained the printed OLS coefficient rather than deriving Cohen's f^2. The same-test p is printed as 0.017895 in paragraph 12, retained here as context only because p_r is unassigned. Original side and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
